title: Salt Minded Fishing Charters

services.name: Fall Fishing
services.desc: This season looks like it will be extending a little longer than most. Bookings are WAY up in October and November. Typically, the business dries up before the fishing - so I don’t really have much of a report during the later part of the season. However, we should continue to catch speckled trout, reds, and stripers will into November. I have had years where I caught fishing into mid January consistently. I will be running trips most likely into Christmas time this year so give me a shout and we can get you in the books during your extended Outer Banks stay! Thanks everyone for
